title: Predicting Privileged Information Effectiveness for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.22512v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from privileged information (PI) without a separate teacher model. However, prior work largely treats PI as a fixed design choice, leaving the effects of its content and construction poorly understood. This challenge is particularly important in multi-turn agentic settings, where trajectories contain actions, observations, and reasoning that can be transformed into PI in many ways. We systematically evaluate 16 PI configurations across three multi-turn agentic benchmarks and three student models that vary in scale and reasoning mode. We find that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and the student model. Information-dense trajectories and PI produced by more capable generators generally yield larger gains, whereas thinking models benefit less consistently. translated_title: 预测在线策略自蒸馏中特权信息的有效性
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）使大型语言模型（LLM）能够在没有单独教师模型的情况下从特权信息（PI）中学习。然而，先前的工作大多将特权信息视为固定的设计选择，导致其内容和构建方式的影响尚不明确。这一挑战在多轮智能体环境中尤为重要，因为轨迹中包含动作、观察和推理，可以以多种方式转换为特权信息。我们在三个多轮智能体基准测试和三个在规模与推理模式上各不相同的学生模型上，系统地评估了16种特权信息配置。我们发现，特权信息的有效性取决于其内容、生成来源和学生模型。信息密集的轨迹以及由能力更强的生成器产生的特权信息通常带来更大的收益，而思考型模型的收益则不太一致。为了在训练前评估特权信息，我们将特权信息的效用与两个基于KL散度的指标进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文系统评估了16种特权信息配置在多轮智能体任务在线策略自蒸馏中的效果，发现其有效性取决于内容、生成来源和学生模型，并提出可利用基于KL散度的指标在训练前预测特权信息的效用。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates 16 privileged information configurations for on-policy self-distillation in multi-turn agentic settings, finding that PI effectiveness depends on its content, generation source, and student model, and proposes KL-based metrics to predict PI utility before training.
